generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The bidder shall belong to Category - I community as per Govt. of Karnataka. Valid Category - I certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal.
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself.
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled.
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority.
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes) levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful bidder should strictly adhere &ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code.
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor and same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned.
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (CCM), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours.
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in.
Corrigendum/ modification/ corrections, if any, will be published in the website only.
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid.

Contract Performance Guarantee for CATEGORY-I: Security deposit from the successful bidder for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill of the successful bidder. The Security deposit deducted in RA bill will be released after completion of contract period i.e.,14 months and The work performance shall be Nil months after completing the work. The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract.
The bidder shall be a domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years certified by Govt. of Karnataka. Valid Domicile certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor At least any Construction work of value not less than Rs. 6.24 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) in the last Five financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in At least One financial year a minimum Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs. 24.953 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) during the last five completed financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the certified copy of Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

technicalCriterionList.description: A. I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government/Government of India/ Union Territory. B. I/we declares that EMD has not been forfeited and None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past 3 (Three) years. C. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. D. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. E. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. F. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason.

The bidder shall also upload the Special Declaration for the following points towards Maintenance & Upkeep of Plantation: I/we shall declare the declare that I/we shall strictly adhere the following guidelines and requirement towards the maintenance and upkeep of plantations for duration of entire contract period as specified in the tender1.The plantation of saplings shall be completed within Two(02) month from the date of issue of Letter of Award (LOA). The remaining eleven (12) months shall constitute the maintenance and upkeeping period commencing from the date of completion of plantation work. 2.The contractor shall carry out regular watering to the plants/saplings as per seasonal requirements to ensure healthy growth and survival of saplings. 3.Gap filling shall be carried out promptly by replacing any dead, damaged, diseased or missing saplings at the contractors own cost during the maintenance period.4.Pest and disease management shall be carried out using eco-friendly and organic methods including preventive and curative measures as required.5.The contractor shall maintain adequate mulch around the plants and replenish the mulch layer periodically to conserve moisture and improve soil health condition.6.The contractor shall ensure proper survival, growth and healthy condition of all planted saplings throughout the maintenance/defect liability period specified in the contract.7.Joint survival assessment shall be conducted by the department representatives and the contractor after completion of maintenance period.8.In case of mortality or failure of plants/saplings during maintenance period, the contractor shall replace such plants immediately at his own cost and continue maintenance until the prescribed survival percentage, as decided by the department is achieved.9.The decision of the Engineer-in-Charge regarding plant survival percentage, adequacy of maintenance, replacement requirements, and recovery amount shall be final and binding on the contractor.10.The contractor shall ensure that no plants or saplings fail due to negligence, inadequate maintenance, lack of watering, or insufficient protection during maintenance period.

Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Tender capacity (A x N x 5.0 - B), where A Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 1.16 years. B Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1.16 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Development of afforestation area by gap filling plantation and Replacement of Damaged barbed wire fencing around afforestation areas at RTPS Colony

itemList.description: Dismantling and stacking to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge, fencing posts or struts including all earth work and dismantling of concrete etc. in base of: RCC

Providing and fixing RCC precast fencing pole of size 0.15mx0.15mx2.0m casted in M 20 with 20mm down size aggregates making holes for drawing barbed wire at 30 cm c/c using 8 mm dia vertical 4 TMT steel rods and 6 mm dia stirups at 15 cm c/c fixed 1.5 m above Ground level using steel moulding , curing , transportation to work spot including excavation in all types of soil, fixing in plain cement concrete M15 using 20 mm downsize aggregate including aligning to plumb and line providing including cost of all materials, labour,usage charges of machinery complete.

Fencing  with  G.I. barbed wire R.C.C.  post  placed  at  required  distance,embedded  in  cement concrete blocks, every 15th post, last but one end post and corner post shall be strutted on both sides and end post one side only, provided with horizontal lines and two diagonals of barbed wire weighing 9.38 kg per 100 m (minimum), between the two posts fitted and fixed with G.I. staples on wooden plugs or G.I. binding wire tied to 6 mm bar nibs fixed while casting the post (cost of R.C.C. posts, struts, earth work and concrete to be paid for separately) :- Payment to be made per metre cost of total length of barbed wire used.
Clearing of jungle, bushes, cutting trees upto 15 cm girth including disposing off the  materials etc., complete with all leads and lifts. - Thin jungle (including parthenium growth).

Digging pits of size 0.75 x 0.75x 0.75m, filling  50% of the pit with top soil and remaining 50% of pit with 1:2:3 proportion of sand (0.035cum) FYM (0.070cum) Red earth (0.105 cum) and planting of  well  grown tree saplings (excluding  cost of plants) -For Normal soil.
Supplying  of  honge  plants  of  minimum  3  feet  height  to site including  cost  of  plantations, loading & unloading and  transportation up to site etc.., complete.
Supplying  of  neem  plants  of  minimum  3  feet  height  to  site  including  cost  of  plantations, loading,  unloading and  transportation up to site etc.., complete.

Supplying  of  fruit  bearing  plants  such  as  guava,  custard  apple, Jamun, Jack fruit etc..,  of  minimum  3  feet height  to site including  cost  of  plantations,  loading  & unloading  and  transportation  up  to site etc.., complete.

Supplying  of  flowering  plants  such  as  purple  orchid,  pirik  trumpet,  golden  shower etc..,  of  minimum  3  feet  height  to  site  including cost of plantations, loading & unloading and  transportation up to site etc.., complete.

Providing and fixing  of  2.5   to   3   meter  length  wooden   stakes  of  sufficient  stoutness  and strength   from   departmental   forests/plantations,application   of   coal   tar    to   the   stake, transportation and delivery - complete.

Providing watering to saplings in RTPS afforestation area in colony using water tanker including, filling tanker, transportation of water, spraying/watering, hose pipe arrangement, labour, tanker hire charges, fuel, operation, maintenance, complete as directed by Engineer-in-Charge.
Scraping of grass and other growth around the plant  (Pits)  (iv) 90   cm.   radius around  the  plant.
Hoeing & soil working with  pick  axe  around  the  plant  to a depth of  15cm. & to  a  radius of 60  cm.  so  as  to  loosen  the  soil around  the plants.
Supply of inputs such as sand,FYM, Red earth in1:3:6 ratio mixing and spreading the mixture to 7.50cm thickness wherever required.

Supply and spreading of the DAP (Di- ammonium Phosphate)- 50kg/bag inorganic fertilizers and pesticides as per directed by engineer -in charge including cost of all consumables with all and lifts etc., complete.
